customNotes.content:
TRENDS TAB — feature spec (chart impl currently DISCARDED; data layer must be rebuilt from scratch next session).

API CONTRACT:
1. Config: GET {baseUrl}/protected/config/site/:id → response.siteComponents.trends[] (array). Already fetched via useSiteConfig(siteId).
2. Data: GET {baseUrl}/protected/data/v2/trends/:siteId?idx={N}&start={expr}&end={expr}&tz={IANA}
   - idx = 0-based index of the trend item in siteComponents.trends[] (1:1 mapping).
   - start/end are SQL-ish expressions, e.g. start="now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR", end="now()". Custom range uses quoted absolute literals "'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'".
   - tz e.g. "Asia/Karachi" (use device tz via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone).
   - Response: { metadata, data: [{ time: <unix ms>, <param>: <number|null>, ... }] }. Each row = one time bucket; keys after `time` match each aggregation's `param`.

CONFIG FIELD WHITELIST (user was EMPHATIC — use ONLY these, ignore everything else):
   - trend.heading, trend.subHeading
   - trend.payload.unit (for x-axis label granularity)
   - trend.payload.aggregations[].{ color, display, type, param }
     - type ∈ line | area | column | bar  (drives the series render type)
     - param matches the data-row key
   - IGNORE: id, dataStore, poll (NO polling), chartConfig, payload.chartType (NO pie special-casing), payload.interval, agg.method, agg.chartType, top-level type.

RENDERING REQUIREMENTS (user-stated):
   - ALL aggregations of one trend render in ONE MERGED chart frame (line+area+column+bar coexisting on shared axes). NOT split panes.
   - Zoom in / zoom out controls per chart.
   - Horizontal left/right scroll/pan with y-axis PINNED (stays visible while plot scrolls).
   - Default period filter = 24H. Pills: 24H / 72H / 7D / 30D / Custom.
   - x-axis date format DD/MM (e.g. 25/05).
   - Hide on-tap tooltip/legend popup ("not needed").

TRENDS CHART — hard-won learnings from the DISCARDED attempt (read before re-attempting charts).

LIBRARY LANDSCAPE (already in package.json, committed): @wuba/react-native-echarts ^3.0.1, react-native-echarts-pro ^1.9.3, react-native-gifted-charts ^1.4.71, react-native-svg 15.3.0, react-native-reanimated 3.16.7. react-native-skia is NOT installed.

WHAT FAILED:
1. gifted-charts: cannot cleanly merge line+area+column+bar in ONE frame at native quality. Forced into 2-pane split (LineChart + BarChart). Rejected by user.
2. @wuba/react-native-echarts (SVG renderer) WORKS for combo charts but is dependency hell on RN/Metro/Hermes:
   - echarts core is NOT a dep of the wrapper — must `yarn add echarts`. echarts 6.x is ESM-only ("type":"module") and crashes Metro at module-eval. PIN echarts to ^5.5/5.6.
   - The wrapper pulls zrender 6.x to top-level while echarts 5.6 ships nested zrender 5.6.1 → setPlatformAPI set on the wrong zrender → "Cannot read property '__extends' of undefined". FIX: pin zrender ~5.6.1 to dedupe.
   - zrender's nested tslib 2.3.0 has a broken ESM entry (modules/index.js) under Metro strict-mode interop → same __extends crash. FIX: package.json "resolutions": { "tslib": "^2.8.1" }.
   - Import the wrapper from the DEEP entry '@wuba/react-native-echarts/svgChart' (NOT package root) — root re-exports the Skia variant and Metro statically resolves @shopify/react-native-skia which isn't installed.
   - Top-level imports of echarts/wrapper cascade-crash the whole src/components barrel (symptom: "Cannot read property 'Splash' of undefined" in Onboarding). FIX: lazy require() all echarts modules inside the component body on first mount, cache at module scope.
   - echarts.init needs an EXPLICIT numeric width (Dimensions-based); width:undefined → blank zero-width canvas.
   - dataZoom type:'inside' with moveOnMouseMove:true is what enables finger-pan in RN (the wrapper's PanResponder feeds touch through the mouse pipeline). preventDefaultMouseMove:true stops the parent vertical ScrollView stealing horizontal swipes.
   - Wildly different magnitudes (line ~3K vs bar ~5M) need DUAL Y-AXES (bars yAxisIndex:0 left, lines/areas yAxisIndex:1 right) + z-order (lines/areas z>bars) or the small series is an invisible flat sliver / hidden behind bars.

UNTESTED ALTERNATIVE for next time: react-native-echarts-pro (WebView-based, bundles its own echarts — sidesteps ALL the Metro/ESM/zrender/tslib dependency hell above) OR victory-native. Consider these before re-fighting @wuba dependency issues.

CURRENT STATE: all trend chart + data-layer work reverted to commit 789cadb. TrendView is back to the mock-driven GradientRangeBar + TrendAnalysisCard. No getTrendData, no useTrendData, no trend types. echarts/zrender deps + tslib resolution removed from package.json.

`pod install` via the Bash tool / non-interactive shells CRASHES with "Unicode Normalization not appropriate for ASCII-8BIT (Encoding::CompatibilityError)" (CocoaPods 1.15.2). FIX: set a UTF-8 locale → `cd ios && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 pod install`. Always export those before running pod install in automation.

TRENDS TAB — REBUILT (supersedes the old "trends-chart-spec / DISCARDED, rebuild from scratch" note; that note is now STALE). Current implementation under src/components/screens/Authenticated/SiteDetail/components/Trends/:
- Data layer: types/trends.ts, getTrendData() (networking/site), useTrendData() hook, utils/trends.ts (selectTrends config selector, buildTrendRange SQL exprs, splitAggregations, formatTrendLabel, period pills 24H/48H/72H/Custom, custom max 3 days). TrendView maps siteConfig.siteComponents.trends[] → one TrendSection per idx; each owns its own period filter + fetch; fires API on mount, defers chart mount via useInteractionReady (skeleton meanwhile).
- Charts: gifted-charts for the split (line/area in TrendLineChart, bar/column in TrendBarChart) — used on sections 1+. Section 0 is the PROTOTYPE combined chart via react-native-echarts-pro (WebView, bundles own echarts — sidesteps the @wuba dependency hell). echartsOption.ts builds the option: detailed=false → compact dual-axis (bars left/lines right, no y-axis titles, y-tick labels shown, default zoom window ~40 buckets); detailed=true → one colour-coded y-axis PER series + every x label (used only in fullscreen).
- Fullscreen: TrendChartFullscreenModal.tsx = portrait-LOCKED Modal (supportedOrientations=['portrait']) with content rotated 90deg (rotate-transform trick; NO orientation lib). NOTCH_INSET(40,left)/RIGHT_INSET(20,right) clear the camera + axis clipping. Title+Export+Close in a centered header row.
- Export: exportChart.ts uses RNEChartsPro ref.getInstance('getDataURL',{type:'png',pixelRatio:2,backgroundColor}) → base64 PNG → react-native-share Share.open({url:dataURL}). react-native-share@12.3.1 added (native dep — needs pod install + rebuild). Export button on inline card + fullscreen header.
PENDING/UNVERIFIED on device: whether to keep echarts-pro combo for ALL sections vs gifted split; touch through the rotate-transform; default zoom density.

CHARTING — fully migrated to echarts (react-native-echarts-pro, WebView). `react-native-gifted-charts` has been REMOVED from package.json (it was pure-JS; react-native-svg stays for icons, so no rebuild needed for the removal). Updates the earlier trends note: there is NO gifted/echarts split anymore — ALL trend sections use TrendComboChart (echarts combo), and the Reports tab (PerformanceReportCard) pie donut + stacked bar are now echarts too via PerformanceReport/echartsReportOption.ts (buildReportPieOption + buildReportStackBarOption). Pie slice tap → RNEChartsPro onPress(params.dataIndex) → setSelectedIndex (highlights source row). Stacked bar uses echarts dataZoom slider for zoom/scroll (replaced the manual ZoomControls). echarts click events route to onPress only when type==='click'. NOTE: `@wuba/react-native-echarts` (3.0.1) is still in package.json but UNUSED (unmet zrender peer) — safe to remove as cleanup; we use react-native-echarts-pro exclusively.
